facts.statement: A community Festival of Hearts semi-formal dance was held on Friday February 12, 2010, billed as the first annual one, with the dress code semi-formal.
facts.quote: join us for our first annual Festival of Hearts Semi-formal dance!

facts.statement: The semi-formal dance ran on Server 1 at 3pm Pacific Time for U.S. and Latin America, which the article lists as 9:00am Pacific / 6:00pm GMT for UK and Europe (the UK/Europe entry is printed with the same Server 1 line).
facts.quote: 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Festival of Hearts Semi-Formal Dance
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community event announcement for the first annual Festival of Hearts Semi-Formal dance, held on Friday February 12, 2010 on Server 1 at two times for US/Latin America and UK/Europe. The page also gives the in-game Game Guide calendar steps for finding community events and using the GO button to teleport to them. The post date is not shown; it is only given relative to capture ('2 days, 5 hours ago').
